label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: No alzarás el nombre de Jehová tu Dios a la vanidad, porque no dejará limpio Jehová al que alza su nombre a la vanidad.
spanish: No alzarás el nombre de Jehová tu Dios a la vanidad, porque no dejará limpio Jehová al que alzare su nombre a la vanidad.
grammarChanges: Changed the relative-clause verb from present indicative 'alza' to future subjunctive 'alzare' (h02020007014) to preserve the qal imperfect 3ms's open future/general force cited by the audit, instead of a closed present-tense reading.
readerNote: Chose future subjunctive 'alzare' over present 'alza' to keep the Hebrew imperfect open to future/general action, per the audit's cited mismatch.
